title: Harbor and Kitchen
author: Marguerite Hartwell
blurb: Jude Marchetti, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
